documents.title: Museum opening hours
documents.content: The city museum is open from 9 AM to 5 PM Tuesday through Sunday. Tickets can be booked online.

documents.title: Airport rail information
documents.content: The airport express train operates every 20 minutes between the airport and the city center.

documents.title: Coastal walking guide
documents.content: A coastal promenade has paved oceanfront walking paths and scenic photography viewpoints.

documents.title: Dietary information
documents.content: The restaurant offers vegetarian and vegan dishes and can accommodate several food allergies.

documents.title: Hotel cancellation policy
documents.content: Hotel bookings can be canceled without a fee until 48 hours before arrival.

documents.title: Trail access guide
documents.content: Mountain hiking routes require sturdy shoes and can close in severe weather.

documents.title: Entry requirements
documents.content: Travelers must verify passport validity and entry visa requirements with official authorities.

documents.title: Business trip expenses
documents.content: Business travel expense reports require dated receipts for meals, hotels, and transportation.
